topics.name: Whole numbers: counting, ordering, comparing, representing and place value
subtopics: Revision of Grade 3 work (integrated into the topics)
Count forwards and backwards in 2s, 3s, 5s, 10s, 25s, 50s and 100s between 0 and at least 10 000
Order, compare and represent numbers to at least four-digit numbers
Represent odd and even numbers to at least 1 000
Recognise the place value of digits in whole numbers to at least four-digit numbers
Round off to the nearest 10, 100 and 1 000

topics.name: Number sentences
subtopics: Write number sentences to describe problem situations
Solve and complete number sentences by inspection, trial and improvement, and checking by substitution
Recognise and use the commutative, associative and distributive properties of operations with whole numbers
0 in terms of its additive property

topics.name: Whole numbers: addition and subtraction
subtopics: Addition and subtraction of whole numbers of at least 4 digits

Use any two techniques to perform and check written and mental calculations: estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, number line, rounding off and compensating, addition and subtraction as inverse operations
Solve problems involving whole numbers in financial and measurement contexts

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Assignment
subtopics: Assignment on whole numbers (counting, ordering and representing), number sentences, and addition and subtraction, completed in class within three hours

topics.name: Whole numbers: multiplication
subtopics: Multiplication of one-digit numbers by numbers up to 10
Multiplication of at least a two-digit number by a one-digit number, and of two-digit by two-digit numbers
Use any two techniques to perform and check calculations: estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, doubling and halving, multiplication and division as inverse operations
Multiples of one-digit numbers to at least 100; factors of one-digit numbers to at least 10 and two-digit numbers to at least 100
Solve problems involving whole numbers in financial and measurement contexts, ratio (same kind) and rate (different kinds)

topics.name: Revision
subtopics: Revision of Term 1 topics

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Test on all Term 1 topics

sba: Assignment: whole numbers (counting, ordering and representing), number sentences, addition and subtraction (in class, three hours)

topics.name: Whole numbers: division
subtopics: Division of at least a two-digit number by a one-digit number, and of at least a whole three-digit number by one-digit numbers
Use any two techniques to perform and check calculations: estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, multiplication and division as inverse operations
Solve problems involving whole numbers in financial and measurement contexts, ratio, rate, and grouping and equal sharing with remainders

topics.name: Geometric patterns
subtopics: Investigate and extend geometric patterns looking for relationships or rules, in sequences not limited to a constant difference or ratio and of learners' own creation
Describe observed relationships or rules in learners' own words
Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams
Determine equivalence of descriptions of the same relationship or rule presented verbally, in a flow diagram and by a number sentence

topics.name: Numeric patterns
subtopics: Investigate and extend numeric patterns involving a constant difference or ratio, and of learners' own creation
Describe observed relationships or rules for sequences involving constant difference or ratio in learners' own words
Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams and tables
Determine equivalence of descriptions presented verbally, in a flow diagram, in a table and by a number sentence

topics.name: Properties of 2D shapes
subtopics: Recognise, visualise and name 2D shapes in the environment and geometric settings: regular and irregular polygons (triangles, squares, rectangles, other quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, heptagons) and circles
Describe, sort and compare 2D shapes in terms of straight and curved sides and number of sides
Draw 2D shapes on grid paper

topics.name: Properties of 3D objects
subtopics: Recognise, visualise and name 3D objects in the environment and geometric settings: rectangular prisms, spheres, cylinders and pyramids
Describe, sort and compare 3D objects in terms of shapes of faces, and flat and curved surfaces
Make 3D models using cut-out polygons

topics.name: Symmetry
subtopics: Recognise, draw and describe line(s) of symmetry in 2D shapes

topics.name: Revision and formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Revision
Test on all Term 1 and 2 topics

sba: Investigation: on any ONE of the Term 2 topics, administered before teaching it

topics.name: Common fractions
subtopics: Compare and order common fractions with different denominators (halves, thirds, quarters, fifths, sixths, sevenths and eighths)
Describe and compare common fractions in diagram form
Recognise, describe and use the equivalence of division and fractions
Addition of common fractions with the same denominators
Solve problems in contexts involving fractions, including grouping and equal sharing
Recognise and use equivalent forms of common fractions (denominators which are multiples of one another)

topics.name: Data handling: data cycle
subtopics: Collect data using tally marks and tables for recording
Draw pictographs (one-to-one correspondence) and bar graphs
Critically read and interpret data in words, pictographs, bar graphs and pie charts
Analyse data by answering questions related to data categories
Summarise data verbally and in short written paragraphs, making predictions based on the data

topics.name: Probability
subtopics: Perform simple repeated events (tossing a coin, rolling a die) and list possible outcomes

topics.name: Mass
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using bathroom scales, kitchen scales and balances
Record, compare and order mass in grams (g) and kilograms (kg)
Solve problems in contexts involving mass
Convert between grams and kilograms (whole numbers and fractions)

topics.name: Transformations
subtopics: Put 2D shapes together to make composite shapes, including some with line symmetry
Pack out 2D shapes to make tessellated patterns, including some with line symmetry
Describe patterns in nature, modern everyday life and our cultural heritage referring to lines, 2D shapes, 3D objects and lines of symmetry

topics.name: Revision and formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Revision
Test on all Term 3 topics

sba: Project: covering a combination of topics from Terms 1 to 3, completed before the end of Term 3

topics.name: Time
subtopics: Read, tell and write time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats on analogue and digital instruments (hours, minutes, seconds)
Use clocks, watches and stopwatches; read calendars
Solve problems in contexts involving time
Calculate the number of days between any two dates within the same or consecutive years
Calculate time intervals given in seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years and decades

topics.name: Length
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 2D shapes and 3D objects using rulers, metre sticks, tape measures and trundle wheels
Record, compare and order lengths in millimetres, centimetres, metres and kilometres
Solve problems in contexts involving length
Convert between mm and cm, cm and m, and m and km (whole numbers and common fractions)

topics.name: Perimeter, area and volume
subtopics: Measure perimeter using rulers or measuring tapes
Find areas of regular and irregular shapes by counting squares on grids to develop an understanding of square units
Find volume/capacity of objects by packing or filling them to develop an understanding of cubic units

topics.name: Capacity/volume
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using measuring spoons, cups and jugs
Record, compare and order capacity and volume in millilitres (ml) and litres (l)
Solve problems in contexts involving capacity/volume
Convert between millilitres and litres (whole numbers and fractions)

topics.name: Revision and formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Revision
Test on Term 1 to 4 topics
